issues.description: The template's construct_zero_state_prep_circuit starts by calling stim.Circuit(offset) (passing an integer to the stim.Circuit constructor), while the solution and intended usage construct a plain stim.Circuit() and apply any index offset by relabeling. Passing an integer to stim.Circuit in the template is a structural mismatch and will raise a runtime/constructor error for students attempting to run or test the template code.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template to construct a stim.Circuit() with no integer argument and apply the intended qubit index offset explicitly (e.g., with a relabeling helper or by adding the offset when appending operations). Ensure the template's example and comments align with the solution approach (i.e., use stim.Circuit() and handle offsets separately).
